notes:
Original title and DOI verified against the deposited accepted manuscript at Universidad de Granada (https://digibug.ugr.es/handle/10481/97764). Accepted-manuscript pagination differs from the supplied published-page locator. Extracted the within-morpheme beginner-versus-intermediate contrast; did not substitute between-morpheme contrasts. Original analytic n left null: printed TLU ratios and the 40-text corpus total do not unambiguously establish the raw-frequency test denominator when non-target-like/oversuppliance annotations are included. Replication acquisition failed: supplied Helsinki download returned a bot challenge; handle inaccessible; legacy repository connection refused; an alternate legacy thesis path returned 404; repository bitstream API returned 401. No signed-in or paid acquisition used. Replication authors’ narrative verdict could not be inspected.
Source follow-up: Primary source is the complete University of Helsinki master’s thesis, May 2024. Rendered PDF p.31 Table 4 visually checked: χ2 and p values agree with canonical TXT. Requested printed test statistic retained without conversion. Exact full numeric rows quoted because TXT reading order interleaves row labels; location identifies target column. Analytic test N left null: total learner texts and raw annotation counts are distinct units, and no exact Table 4 denominator is printed. No effect-specific author narrative replication-success verdict located for this exact TLU-rate test; reported_success left null rather than inferred from significance or from NTLU developmental-pattern discussion. The p.30 narrative states that only articles and 3rd person singular -s have p values under 0.05; that is significance commentary, not an explicit replication-success verdict.
Completion source review (n_o): The named morpheme is explicitly identified in the beginner/intermediate raw-frequency critical contrast. Sum uses the printed denominators for mutually exclusive final proficiency groups; analytic units are morpheme annotations/contexts, not the 40 learner texts. Regular nominal plural only; irregular nominal plurals and other lexical categories excluded from annotation.
